facts.text: README documents the topics /gps/duro/current_pose (geometry_msgs/PoseStamped), /gps/duro/fix (sensor_msgs/NavSatFix), /gps/duro/imu (sensor_msgs/Imu), /gps/duro/mag (sensor_msgs/MagneticField), /gps/duro/odom (nav_msgs/Odometry), /gps/duro/rollpitchyaw (geometry_msgs/Vector3), /gps/duro/status_flag (std_msgs/UInt8), /gps/duro/status_string (std_msgs/String) and /gps/duro/time_ref (sensor_msgs/TimeReference).

main advertises the relative publisher names odom, current_pose, current_pose_fake_orientation, fix, mag, imu, rollpitchyaw, rollpitchyaw_fake, status_flag, status_string, time_ref, time_diff and time_gps_str on the default node handle.

The advertise calls declare the message types nav_msgs::Odometry, geometry_msgs::PoseStamped, sensor_msgs::NavSatFix, sensor_msgs::MagneticField, sensor_msgs::Imu, geometry_msgs::Vector3, std_msgs::UInt8, std_msgs::String, sensor_msgs::TimeReference and std_msgs::Float64.
ros::init initializes a ROS 1 node named duro and the publishers are created on a default ros::NodeHandle.

The example launch starts package duro_ros executable duronode with node name duro_driver and sets ip_address, port, gps_receiver_frame_id, imu_frame_id, utm_frame_id, orientation_source and z_coord_ref_switch parameters.

The comment says the first three flag bits are the fix mode (FIX_MODE_POSITION 0, FIX_MODE_MASK 7), and the fix_modes enum sets INVALID = 0 followed by SINGLE_POINT_POSITION, DIFFERENTIAL_GNSS, FLOAT_RTK, FIXED_RTK, DEAD_RECKONING and SBAS_POSITION in that order.

pos_ll_callback masks fix_mode out of the position flags, sets the status text to Invalid and publishes fix_mode as std_msgs::UInt8 with status_flag_pub before the fix_mode > fix_modes::INVALID check; the comment maps 0 Invalid, 1 SPP, 2 DGNSS, 3 Float RTK, 4 Fixed RTK, 5 Dead Reckoning and 6 SBAS.

In pos_ll_callback the odom_pub, fake_pub, pose_pub and nav_fix_pub publications are inside the fix_mode > fix_modes::INVALID branch, and status_stri_pub publishes after that branch closes as the callback's last statement.

The NavSatFix covariance conversion interprets h_accuracy and v_accuracy as millimetres, converts them to metres and squares them for entries 0, 4 and 8, and sets position_covariance_type to COVARIANCE_TYPE_DIAGONAL_KNOWN.
The fix status switch maps DEAD_RECKONING and its default case (a mode it does not implement) to NavSatStatus::STATUS_NO_FIX, and nav_fix_pub.publish(fix) follows the switch.
pose_msg gets the x and y that LatLonToUTMXY computes from latitude and longitude, the utm_frame_id frame and a z chosen by z_coord_ref_switch (zero, exact, zero_based or orig).

When euler_based_orientation is false, orientation_callback scales the SBP quaternion by 2^-31, rotates it by -pi/2 about z and writes swapped and negated components into pose_msg.pose.orientation; the comments call this a left-handed/right-handed conversion.

orientation_euler_callback publishes the roll, pitch and yaw vector with euler_pub and, when euler_based_orientation is true, writes the quaternion of roll, pitch and pi/2 minus yaw into pose_msg.pose.orientation.

fake_pose_msg copies the header and position of pose_msg with a yaw-only orientation from fake_ori.getOri() + pi and is published by fake_pub; pose_pub publishes pose_msg when orientation_source is gps, fake_pose_msg when it is odom, and nothing for any other value.

pos_ll_callback assigns the odom header stamp and utm_frame_id frame, child_frame_id gps_receiver_frame_id and pose.pose.position (UTM x and y, height as z) before odom_pub publishes it; it assigns no odometry orientation, twist or covariance.
The IMU callback converts raw acceleration to m/s2 by dividing by linear_acc_conf and multiplying by 9.80665, and raw gyro to rad/s by dividing by angular_vel_conf and multiplying by 0.01745.
imu_callback builds and publishes an IMU message only when linear_acc_conf > 0, and copies that message's orientation from pose_msg.pose.orientation.
linear_acc_conf and angular_vel_conf start at -1.0.
imu_aux_callback sets linear_acc_conf to 16384, 8192, 4096 or 2048 and angular_vel_conf to 16.4, 32.8, 65.6, 131.2 or 262.4 according to the accelerometer and gyro mode bits of imu_conf.
mag_callback multiplies each raw magnetic component by 1e-6 and the comment labels the body-frame value in microteslas.
orientation_euler_callback divides raw roll, pitch and yaw by 57292374; the comment states the constant converts raw values from microdegrees to radians.

time_callback sets the TimeReference header frame to ros_time, computes time_ref.sec from the GPS week and time-of-week plus 315964782 and time_ref.nsec from the millisecond remainder and ns_residual, and labels the source gps_duro.
The status_string switch assigns Invalid, Single Point Position (SPP), Differential GNSS (DGNSS), Float RTK, Fixed RTK, Dead Reckoning (DR), SBAS Position or Not implemented.
main advertises topic publishers and then registers SBP callbacks and enters the socket loop; it creates no ROS service server or subscriber for commands.
setup_socket creates an AF_INET TCP socket and connects to tcp_ip_addr:tcp_ip_port.
The repository's debug script subscribes to /gps/duro/time_ref.

measures.description: Read one complete sensor_msgs/NavSatFix publication, including its covariance and status; completion means a message arrived, not that the fix is valid or the source is recent
measures.name: read_fix

measures.description: Read one complete sensor_msgs/Imu publication, including three-axis acceleration, angular velocity and the node's orientation copied from pose_msg; the copied orientation is not synchronized with the raw IMU sample
measures.name: read_imu

measures.description: Read one complete sensor_msgs/MagneticField publication, including its covariance array
measures.name: read_mag

measures.description: Read one complete sensor_msgs/TimeReference publication with the source GPS time; completion does not establish absolute accuracy or a fresh source clock
measures.name: read_time_reference

measures.description: Read the numeric fix-mode status published on status_flag
measures.name: read_fix_status

measures.description: Read the human-readable fix status published on status_string
measures.name: read_fix_status_text

measures.description: Read one complete geometry_msgs/PoseStamped publication in the UTM frame; orientation_source may select the odometry-derived fallback
measures.name: read_pose

measures.description: Read one complete nav_msgs/Odometry publication, including the child frame and the pose; the pose orientation is not assigned by pos_ll_callback and keeps the publisher default
measures.name: read_odometry

measures.description: Read one complete geometry_msgs/Vector3 Euler-angle publication
measures.name: read_attitude
